content:
maria_cs: Hey team — kicking off the Indigo preview cohort tomorrow. Need the final enroll list + a one-pager of each customer's primary use case by Friday EOD. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheets/d/indigo-enroll (please don't change the column structure).

tony_csm: @maria_cs sending our list tonight. Do we have a suggested kickoff agenda? Heads-up: ACME needs SSO configured before our run.

maria_cs: Agenda stub: 1) intro + goals 2) API keys & SSO 3) onboarding tasks 4) feedback cadence. I'll paste a minimal template below.

maria_cs: ```Agenda: 30m intro; 30m integration; 15m Q&A; 15m feedback plan. Owners: CS/Tony, Eng/Eli, Enablement/Nora. Deliverable: kickoff notes + action items.```

eli_eng: re SSO — ACME requires IdP metadata (ACS & certificate). We need them to provide ACS URL + cert file. Evan on infra can help wire the metadata once we have it. @nora_enable can you collect that?

nora_enable: I can. I'll schedule a 30-min enablement slot next Tue 10:00-10:30 PT to collect details and demo the auth flow. Is that ok? @tony_csm

tony_csm: Works for ACME. Also quick ask on telemetry: could we enable debug-level token tracing for the pilot for a short window? Need token-level latency breakdowns for the first 48 hours.

eli_eng: We can enable debug retention but prefer to limit to 24h to avoid high egress/cost. If you pick a small window (e.g., Tue 08:00 PT) we can do 24h and export the traces.

maria_cs: OK let's aim for a 24h debug window starting Tue 08:00 PT. Tony to confirm exact start.

tony_csm: Confirmed — I'll update the sheet and notify ACME. :thumbsup:

remind-bot: Reminder set — "Indigo preview enroll list due" on Fri 17:00 UTC.

maria_cs: Also: capture two hypothesis fields for each customer in the sheet: "primary_success_metric" and "failure_mode" — we'll use these for quality evals and regression alerts.

nora_enable: Adding columns now: success_metric, failure_mode, SSO_ready (yes/no), kickoff_window. Pls fill by EOD Fri.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, DM me; otherwise I'll post the final agenda Wed AM and create the rollout checklist in the repo.
